vectors.name: Canonical checkout and import origin
vectors.method: Resolve Git top-level, full SHA, dirty state, worktrees, and __file__ for target imports.
vectors.expected: Source manifest identifies one selected worktree; stale duplicate imports rejected.

vectors.name: Preserve original artifacts
vectors.method: Hash original frozen gate/rehearsal and user edits before and after implementation.
vectors.expected: No protected byte changes; new audit supplements separate.

vectors.name: Changed score artifact
vectors.method: Alter one score in an isolated result copy.
vectors.expected: Verifier refuses; independent recomputation does not accept the altered aggregate.

vectors.name: Changed score plus run manifest
vectors.method: Alter score and its run-owned expected digest together.
vectors.expected: Trusted external anchor or independent raw-prediction scorer detects disagreement.

vectors.name: Changed evaluator plus run digest
vectors.method: Replace scorer with always-pass and edit its run-owned hash.
vectors.expected: External evaluator identity rejects it before scoring.

vectors.name: Prediction/split identity
vectors.method: Inject duplicate, missing, extra and foreign-split prediction IDs.
vectors.expected: Explicit rejection; no denominator silently shrinks.

vectors.name: Unsafe paths and nonfinite values
vectors.method: Inject traversal paths, unsupported formats, NaN/infinity in result fields.
vectors.expected: Reject without arbitrary load/execute; no favorable default.

vectors.name: State-dependent rounds
vectors.method: Run AST/dataflow checks and hook real round inputs across a multi-hop fixture.
vectors.expected: Updated hidden state influences messages; unused-block defect absent.

vectors.name: Two-hop sensitivity and null
vectors.method: Change a task-relevant edge two hops away; add a truly irrelevant control edit.
vectors.expected: Propagation changes where expected and null invariant explained; no reasoning score inferred from magnitude alone.

vectors.name: Real optimizer path
vectors.method: Execute permitted real-learner steps, not stand-in; inspect update records.
vectors.expected: Weights actually update, planned schedule/clip fields present, counters agree.

vectors.name: Schedule step accounting
vectors.method: Compare uninterrupted and resumed schedule including replay-only checks.
vectors.expected: Main-step index and learning rate identical; replay does not advance main schedule silently.

vectors.name: Hard assignment contract
vectors.method: Test duplicate row maxima on doubly stochastic counterexample, ties, masks, rectangular cases if supported.
vectors.expected: Task-legal complete/partial assignment or typed refusal; no duplicate target under bijection contract.

vectors.name: Ladder same-item baselines
vectors.method: Run exact scorer and simple baselines on identical ladder records.
vectors.expected: Per-kind/size/hop counts reconcile; old gate untouched; no new-name-only topology claim.

vectors.name: Strict checkpoint identity
vectors.method: Try 1.0 checkpoint in incompatible 2.0 model without migration.
vectors.expected: Refuse; migration separately lists dropped/new tensors and new identity.

vectors.name: Forty-index permutation
vectors.method: Enumerate all 40 meanings through domain-major/noetic-major/tokenizer mappings.
vectors.expected: Bijection, exact semantic round-trip, unknown IDs rejected.

vectors.name: Separate 28 namespaces
vectors.method: Use same numeric index from three namespace labels.
vectors.expected: No implicit equality or cast; unsupported mapping yields explicit error.

vectors.name: Reference contract differential
vectors.method: Compare independent declared semantics and pinned engine on finite supported inputs/errors.
vectors.expected: Agreement or quarantined semantic discrepancy; no target redefinition to hide it.

vectors.name: Parameterized reference classification
vectors.method: Inspect FiLM/RPM/descent signatures, parameters and side effects.
vectors.expected: Only frozen specified behavior admitted; trainable/ambiguous behavior labeled and excluded until contracted.

vectors.name: Modulo simplification baseline
vectors.method: Enumerate compose pairs/triples and evaluate modulo-sum baseline.
vectors.expected: Commutative/associative semantics recognized for quoted rule; no order claim from this family alone.

vectors.name: Behavior record schema
vectors.method: Validate good, invalid-input, missing-prerequisite and unsupported-operation examples.
vectors.expected: Typed status/result and exact source bindings; no silently invented expected answer.

vectors.name: Input/target separation
vectors.method: Inspect serialized inference packet, feature construction and file permissions.
vectors.expected: No targets, verifier answer trace, answer-bearing labels/IDs, or hidden oracle calls accessible.

vectors.name: Structure-first disjointness
vectors.method: Generate split fingerprints before paraphrase and arbitrary rename.
vectors.expected: No declared protected topology/template family crosses splits; overlaps explicitly measured.

vectors.name: Answer shortcut suite
vectors.method: Run substring, type-equality, cardinality, one-hop, bag and exact-code baselines where relevant.
vectors.expected: Useful easy tasks retained as controls; invalid shortcut-supported reasoning claims excluded.

vectors.name: Paraphrase meaning and ambiguity
vectors.method: Check deterministic variants plus role-swapped near matches against bindings.
vectors.expected: Same-meaning variants agree; changed bindings differ; ambiguous cases not forced to a false unique label.

vectors.name: Order-preserving representation
vectors.method: Encode two supported role/order-sensitive expressions with same bag of tokens.
vectors.expected: Candidate retains distinguishable structure; bag collision documented as control.

vectors.name: Free-running canonical reconstruction
vectors.method: Encode held-out expression, remove original sequence/AST access where strict bottleneck claimed, decode without teacher targets.
vectors.expected: Canonical expression score reported by length/depth; invalid outputs count as errors.

vectors.name: No hidden bottleneck side channel
vectors.method: Disable raw input pointers, parse-tree skip, target cache and metadata during strict reconstruction test.
vectors.expected: No undeclared source recovery; permitted structured memory explicitly reported as non-strict.

vectors.name: Typed operation consistency
vectors.method: Execute isolated learned candidate and compare D_k(M_k(E_k(x))) with held-back T_k(x).
vectors.expected: Exact typed-result agreement scored; oracle never executes inside candidate.

vectors.name: Learned versus fixed-path tracing
vectors.method: Patch reference inference aliases to raise and trace accesses in learned arm.
vectors.expected: Learned prediction proceeds without reference; hybrid baseline labeled independently.

vectors.name: Unsupported and invalid behavior
vectors.method: Exercise out-of-subset operator, wrong arity, missing prerequisite and numeric bound.
vectors.expected: Typed refusal/error contract; invalid conditions do not become confident success.

vectors.name: Binding correction intervention
vectors.method: Freeze model, inject one intermediate binding error, correct only that binding, continue same downstream modules.
vectors.expected: Predefined expected restoration measured without final-answer patch; all eligible cases counted.

vectors.name: Natural versus artificial error cohorts
vectors.method: Separate spontaneous model misbindings from injected errors.
vectors.expected: Distinct denominators and results; synthetic repair not advertised as universal self-correction.

vectors.name: Sham and irrelevant changes
vectors.method: Apply no-op and semantically irrelevant intervention chosen by reference semantics.
vectors.expected: Decoded outcome invariant under preregistered tolerance/cohort rule.

vectors.name: Non-vacuous corruption
vectors.method: Construct wrong-role/operator patch known to alter the reference outcome.
vectors.expected: Positive control can change outcome; globally consistent renaming not treated as corruption.

vectors.name: Three-arm fairness
vectors.method: Audit information, useful parameter count, compute, training data and tuning accesses in A/B/C.
vectors.expected: Differences declared; no extra gold concepts or inactive dummy parameters to manufacture parity.

vectors.name: CAS path causal participation
vectors.method: Ablate/replace CAS intermediate path and compare with heads-only control.
vectors.expected: Evidence distinguishes used computation from post-hoc labeling or bypass.

vectors.name: Final evaluation custody
vectors.method: Attempt learner access to final labels or example-level final feedback during development.
vectors.expected: Denied or EVALUATION_NOT_INDEPENDENT; exposed set relabeled as development.

vectors.name: Metric denominators and uncertainty
vectors.method: Independently recompute strata and paired cluster-aware comparisons from raw records.
vectors.expected: Counts reconcile; seeds/world families not falsely treated as independent rows; no automatic benefit pass.

vectors.name: Experimental Helm integration
vectors.method: Run new typed packet through experimental adapter and instrument recurrent consumption.
vectors.expected: Types/bindings influence computation, not just inspector; legacy baseline still works.

vectors.name: Prediction/verification distinction
vectors.method: Supply wrong learned candidate whose verifier can diagnose it.
vectors.expected: Original answer remains wrong in learner score; verified or hybrid correction separately recorded.

vectors.name: RPA export and focus isolation
vectors.method: Export versioned trace and inspect input/module/intervention/evidence identities.
vectors.expected: No reinterpretation as runtime0.2; navigation cannot alter actual model or state.

vectors.name: Fresh-process reload and resume
vectors.method: Persist full model/optimizer/RNG/cursor; reload isolated process and replay next legal step.
vectors.expected: Declared byte/numeric and exact-semantic policy satisfied; all saved-state parts accounted.

vectors.name: Crash cut accounting
vectors.method: Interrupt between update/checkpoint/receipt boundaries in disposable run.
vectors.expected: No double update or skipped charge; source/cursor/optimizer recover or typed refusal.

vectors.name: Source mutation during run
vectors.method: Alter a source dependency of an isolated frozen-run copy.
vectors.expected: Run refuses or invalidates claim; no mutable source race accepted.

vectors.name: CCDL declared edges only
vectors.method: Parse supported fixtures containing explicit versus missing/prose-only connections.
vectors.expected: Declared edges preserved; ambiguity refused/excluded with reason; no silent inference.

vectors.name: Typed ports and feedback
vectors.method: Exercise cause/bias/effect roles, multi-input incidence and feedback graph.
vectors.expected: Role/direction preserved; signal cycles not confused with containment cycles.

vectors.name: Board benchmark categories
vectors.method: Compare direct lookup controls with multi-step and construction tasks.
vectors.expected: Direct facts may be easy; reasoning claim requires corresponding harder evidence.

vectors.name: Fresh board family holdout
vectors.method: Evaluate newly generated sealed structural families, not read book examples.
vectors.expected: Known boards treated as regressions; test families unavailable to developers/learner.

vectors.name: Resources and worker lifecycle
vectors.method: Inspect exact permission record and job commands; simulate exceeded budget/tool timeout.
vectors.expected: No new spend/forbidden training; only owned process controlled; resume path recorded.

vectors.name: Commit, push and rollback
vectors.method: Check actual owner branch rule, source secret scan, commit ancestry and rollback.
vectors.expected: Authorized branch preserved/pushed as required; no force push/production merge; unresolved remote issue explicit.

vectors.name: No skipped-to-pass promotion
vectors.method: Build report with required test missing/skipped and a high raw score.
vectors.expected: Affected gate INCOMPLETE, not PASS; historical evidence not reassigned.

vectors.name: Independent end-to-end demonstration
vectors.method: Reviewer runs documented task, learned operation, internal correction, reload and unsupported case.
vectors.expected: Reproducible bounded demo with separate engineering/representation/operation/benefit statuses.

scope_note: These vectors specify future implementation tests. Package and mathematical checks do not execute Helm or satisfy these vectors.
